policy.purpose: Rights-governed visual inventory for public cards and video compositions.
policy.selection_rule: Only use an asset when its file-level license permits the intended use and all attribution/derivative conditions can be met.
policy.identity_rule: Category-context imagery must never be presented as the product named in a card unless asset.product_identity matches that product version.
policy.exact_product_gap: No reusable VITURE Luma Pro product photograph is currently approved. These assets depict Google Glass and are category context only.
